thread:
mira: quick design check - i uploaded a compact-diff prototype in Figma (link). main asks: toolbar density on narrow widths, keyboard flow for compact approvals, CTA copy, and scanline contrast. can product/design + eng skim?
sam: skimmed. looks good but toolbar is crowded under 920px. can we consolidate Compare + Filter into a single overflow icon?
olivia: agree on consolidation. also compact CTA reads 'Approve selection' which feels long. prefer 'Approve' and keep 'Reject' but we need an inline way to collect a reject reason.
kevin: consolidation is fine. important: icon must have aria-expanded and aria-controls, and keyboard focus target. example: `button.icon[aria-expanded="false"][aria-controls="overflow-menu"]` and menu uses role="menu".
mira: thanks @kevin. i'll update the Figma frames to show icon states and focus ring.
a11y-bot: automated scan: scanline border (#cfe8ff) flagged in frame 02 for low contrast on light theme. recommendation: use darker border or add 1px outline to meet 4.5:1.
olivia: could add a subtle drop shadow to lift the scanline without changing core token color. also consider a slightly darker border token.
sam: on mobile the diff summary truncates counts. propose a compact badge that shows "12 changes" and persists in narrow layouts.
kevin: badge OK as non-interactive element. include `aria-label="12 changes"` so screen readers announce it. avoid making it a button.
mira: action items: 1) consolidate Compare/Filter into overflow icon with accessible attributes 2) add non-interactive change-count badge with aria-label 3) CTA copy -> 'Approve' / 'Reject with reason' 4) increase scanline contrast or add outline/drop shadow.
olivia: ux note: for reject reasons prefer a collapsed preview that expands on focus/hover instead of a full textarea per row. keeps density but surfaces intent.
sam: +1. also microcopy tweak: change 'Request review' -> 'Ask for review' for clarity.
kevin: i'll prototyping keyboard nav (role=menu, arrow handling, enter to open) and add unit/a11y tests. eta: tomorrow eod.
qa-bot: created tests: compact-diff-keyboard-nav and approval-reason-expand. scheduled for next CI run.
mira: small visual nit - when a diff row is selected, avoid using identical primary blue for both scanline and left gutter. give them slight hue difference to clarify shapes.
kevin: good call. i'll include token variations in the PR.
olivia: i'll post three microcopy variants here for quick content ops poll.
mira: thanks everyone. i'll update Figma and link the PR/QA tasks back here. :thumbsup:
